title: (BUG) clippy needless_borrows_for_generic_args in metadata_types test
description: crate-jmap-metadata-types/tests/metadata_types.rs:195 has `serde_json::to_value(&Metadata::Annotation(ann)).unwrap()` which fails `-D clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args` on Rust 1.95. Cargo serde_json::to_value takes `T: Serialize` by reference internally, so the explicit `&` is needless. Fix: remove the `&`. Pre-existing — does not block JMAP-j7pa.1 work but breaks workspace-wide `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` gate.
close_reason: Triage 2026-10-19 at 9fdbbbcf, FIXED (3-skeptic check 3/3 upheld): The flagged expression `serde_json::to_value(&Metadata::Annotation(ann))` is no longer in crate-jmap-metadata-types/. A grep for `Metadata::Annotation` in tests/metadata_types.rs finds nothing. Running `git log -S` shows commit 79574370 ("refactor(jmap-metadata-types): rewrite for draft-02") removed it. The only `to_value(&...)` calls left are at tests/metadata_types.rs:85, :101 and :125, and each borrows a local (`info`, `m`) that is used again afterwards (`assert_eq!(info, reparsed)`, `assert_eq!(m, reparsed)`), so clippy does not flag them. I ran `cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-types --all-targets -- -D warnings` at HEAD 9fdbbbcf on rustc 1.99.1. It finished with exit code 0 and no warnings. I also ran `cargo test -p jmap-metadata-types --test metadata_types`: 15 passed, 0 failed. The premise is gone (the line was removed in a rewrite), and the clippy gate the bead cares about is clean
